text:
tara: Heads-up: onboarding sample app showed "Auth failed" for a user with an expired refresh token. No CTA, they hit support.

leo: Oof. We should return a more structured error so SDKs can show a reconnect button.

mina: Minimal proposal: API returns error_code (dot.namespace), user_message (UI-safe), intent (reauth|fatal|backoff|request_scope), optional retry_after. SDKs map to typed errors or typed return values.

leo: Mapping sketch: 401 + code=="token.expired" -> auth.token_expired / intent=reauth / user_message="Session expired. Reconnect to continue."; 401+invalid -> auth.invalid_credentials / intent=fatal; 403 -> auth.missing_scope / intent=request_scope; 429 -> rate.limit_exceeded / intent=backoff / retry_after header.

mina: Parity note: JS/Py should throw typed exceptions with fields {code,intent,user_message,retry_after}. Go should return typed error values with Code() and Intent() helpers.

tara: Action items: draft RFC for canonical error_code namespace; small sampleapp change to surface CTAs; add unit tests mocking 401/403/429.

ci-bot: summary: Proposed stable codes: auth.token_expired, auth.invalid_credentials, auth.missing_scope, rate.limit_exceeded, service.error. Add fields: error_code, user_message, intent, retry_after.
